title: Evidence-Aware Risk-Bounded Access-Key Policy Selection for Zero-Trust Data Centers: Research Artifact
description: Research artifact v1.2.0 preserves the byte-identical primary study and earlier AWS supplements, and adds a source-frozen one-host AWS robustness campaign on 28 October 2026 in project 501250588559/ap-southeast-2. The new campaign retains 539 HTTP responses, 180 boundary-use trials, 191 successful KMS operations correlated with CloudTrail, one unexpected post-DynamoDB-recovery 503, and a cached-source counterexample after an unpublished actual guest posture change. Matched route timing separates issuance, use, observed warm/cold state and controller pacing. Code/environment rollback and stopped host were verified. A retrospective primary comparator finds no outcome advantage over empirical screening or fixed P60; 53 primary files remain unchanged. Public clean-extraction reanalysis reproduces numerical results, 12 offline tests pass, and altered data are rejected. Requests and sequential benchmark blocks do not replace independent host-days. No new primary certificate, hardware-attestation, independent-site, settled-billing, or production claim. Credentials, private keys, tokens, live permits, private journals, rollback configurations and the formatted manuscript PDF are excluded. Code MIT; original measurements/documentation CC BY 4.0.
